units.source_text: 我赴京都，自料难于久住。

en.t: I am going to Kyoto, but I expect it will be hard for me to stay there long.

units.source_text: 倘有变故，当随时还乡，不会舍弃这故居。

en.t: If anything happens, I shall return home at once, and I will not abandon this old dwelling.

units.source_text: 如此看来，你我还可会面。

en.t: In that case, you and I may still be able to meet again.

units.source_text: 但念今后须暂时抛弃你在此孤苦度日，我便无心前往了。

en.t: But when I think that I must leave you here for a time to spend your days in loneliness and hardship, I lose all heart to go.

units.source_text: 惟身为尼僧之人，亦不必终身闭居。

en.t: Even one who has become a nun need not shut herself away for her whole life.

units.source_text: 还望你体念人世常情，时时入京过访。”

en.t: I hope you will keep ordinary human feelings in mind and come to Kyoto from time to time to visit me."
These words were spoken with great kindness.

units.source_text: 大女公子生前所常用而可作纪念的器物，都留在山庄中，供弁君使用。

en.t: The things the elder young lady had often used in life, and which could serve as keepsakes, were all left at the mountain villa for Ben no Kimi to use.

units.source_text: 二女公子又对她说：“我看你对姐姐的悼念比别人更苦，可知你和她必有特别深厚的前世因缘，便觉你更可亲爱了。”

en.t: The second young lady also said to her, "Seeing that you mourn my elder sister more bitterly than others, I know that you and she must have shared an especially deep bond from a former life, and that makes you seem all the dearer to me."

units.source_text: 弁君听了这话，越发恋恋不舍，就像孩子一般号哭起来，无法自慰，一任泪如雨下。

en.t: When Ben no Kimi heard these words, she grew still more reluctant to part, and began wailing like a child, unable to comfort herself as her tears fell like rain.
